title: Protection and Advocacy for Voting Access Program Inclusion Act
official_summary:
Protection and Advocacy for Voting Access Program Inclusion Act or the PAVA Program Inclusion Act

This bill authorizes the Department of Health and Human Services to distribute Protection and Advocacy for Voting Access (PAVA) program grants to the protection and advocacy systems of the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands and the American Indian consortium.

summary.headline: This law lets the Department of Health and Human Services give voting access grants to advocacy groups in the Northern Mariana Islands and an American Indian consortium.
summary.what_it_does: The law allows HHS to distribute Protection and Advocacy for Voting Access (PAVA) program grants to the protection and advocacy system of the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands. It also allows those grants to go to the protection and advocacy system of an American Indian consortium. The summary does not describe the specific activities those grants must fund.

who_it_affects.group: People with disabilities in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands
who_it_affects.how: The territory's protection and advocacy system can now receive federal PAVA grants to work on voting access for people with disabilities.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the American Indian consortium covered by the law
who_it_affects.how: The consortium's protection and advocacy system can now receive federal PAVA grants to work on voting access for people with disabilities.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on September 30, 2022, and the summary does not list a separate later effective date.
